builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Seacliff Dwarf harbor guard, Fighter 1
traits: Lawful good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +2. Iron Will adds +2 to Will.
+2 racial on saves against poison and +2 racial on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
Stonecunning. +4 dodge AC against giants while dodge bonuses apply. No racial attack bonus against orcs or goblinoids.

Strong Swimmers gives +2 racial on Swim checks and doubles the Constitution score used to calculate breath-holding time. Seacliff dwarves use normal Swim checks and breathe air. Constitution 16 gives 64 calm rounds with the cited DMG baseline, or 32 with Stormwrack p. 11. Track exertion under the chosen procedure.
Dwarven waraxe counts as martial. Weapon Focus (dwarven waraxe) is the Fighter bonus feat.
actions: Dwarven waraxe +5 melee, 1d10+3 slashing one-handed, critical ×3. Shortspear +4 melee for 1d6+3 piercing or +2 thrown above water, range increment 20 ft.

On a successful Swim check move up to 5 ft. as a move action or 10 ft. as a full-round action. Use the shortspear’s piercing attack if he must fight underwater. Apply the normal Swim or firm-footing requirement for an unpenalized underwater attack.
builds.tactics: Brott dives to cut a jammed line in the lower harbor passage. He returns to the landing before using his waraxe and braces on firm stone when he has to hold the gate.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Seacliff Dwarf stone-passage scout, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0. Skill Focus (Search) adds +3 to Search.
+2 racial on saves against poison and +2 racial on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
Stonecunning gives +2 Search to notice unusual stonework and permits a check within 10 ft. Trapfinding also permits her to search for other difficult traps.

Strong Swimmers gives +2 racial on Swim checks and doubles the Constitution score used to calculate breath-holding time. Seacliff dwarves use normal Swim checks and breathe air. Constitution 14 gives 56 calm rounds with the cited DMG baseline, or 28 with Stormwrack p. 11. Track exertion under the chosen procedure.

+4 dodge AC against giants while dodge bonuses apply. No racial attack bonus against orcs or goblinoids. Sneak attack +1d6 against a flanked target or one denied Dexterity to AC, if the target has no concealment.
actions: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. The piercing attack avoids the usual slashing and bludgeoning penalties underwater when she has firm footing or succeeds on her Swim check.
Search +11 for unusual stonework. Check the groove around the flooded passage door before touching the release.
builds.tactics: Vessa inspects the stonework before flooding reaches the next landing. She can slip under the water to check the passage but returns to air before trying the release.

concepts.name: Brott Saltbrace
concepts.motive: Free the harbor gate while the lower line is submerged.
concepts.hook: Brott can reach the jammed line through the flooded passage.

concepts.name: Vessa Mere
concepts.motive: Find the dry exit before the water reaches the next landing.
concepts.hook: Vessa spotted a recent seam in the wall beside the passage door.
